top_choice_rationale: P002 pairs two achievements that each reduce to a defined chemical reaction or mechanism with independent reproduction. Base editing (programmable cytidine and adenosine deamination without double-strand cleavage, with evolved TadA as real enzyme chemistry) is credited to Liu alone, and cereblon identification as the thalidomide target (Handa) together with the PROTAC concept (Crews) is already medicine. Three names keep each attribution clean, though Kondo and Nishida's competing deaminase fusion and the omission of Deshaies and Ciulli are real costs. P001 follows because it keeps the same base-editing part and adds well-characterised C-N coupling, but it sits close to the 2010 prize. P004 is the one-part base-editing fallback, and no award is last.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; dNTP and DNA-repair work is thematically adjacent to base editing and the ubiquitin-proteasome system, but there is no collaboration with Liu, Crews, Handa or other credited names.
